title: Long exact cohomology sequence of a short exact sequence of cochain complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $0\to K_1\xrightarrow{f}K_2\xrightarrow{g}K_3\to0$ a sequence of cochain complexes of $\mathcal C$ (indexed by $\mathbf N$ or $\mathbf Z$) which is short exact in each degree. Then there are morphisms $\delta^n:H^n(K_3)\to H^{n+1}(K_1)$ such that $\cdots\to H^n(K_1)\xrightarrow{H^n(f)}H^n(K_2)\xrightarrow{H^n(g)}H^n(K_3)\xrightarrow{\delta^n}H^{n+1}(K_1)\xrightarrow{H^{n+1}(f)}H^{n+1}(K_2)\to\cdots$ is exact.
